rows.text: On 22 October 2008, the Monetary Council held a special meeting.
On 22 October 2008, the Monetary Council held a special meeting.
After reviewing the latest financial market developments, the Council decided to raise the central bank base rate to 11.50%.
After reviewing the latest financial market developments, the Council decided to raise the central bank base rate to 11.50%.

The Council also decided to narrow the interest rate corridor formed by the overnight deposit and collateralised lending facilities around the rate on the Bank’s key policy instrument to +/-50 basis points.
